Spiced Pepernoten

Served at: Sinterklaas Arrival (Intocht)

Serves 8-10 (makes about 150 small cookies)Prep 25 min (plus 30 min chilling)Cook 15 min

Pepernoten are small, bite-sized spiced cookies, traditionally scattered by Zwarte Piet (Black Pete) during the Sinterklaas celebrations in the Netherlands. Their arrival marks the beginning of the festive season, and these delightful treats are a beloved part of the Sinterklaas feast, often enjoyed by children and adults alike.

Ingredients

  • 1/2 cup (113g) unsalted butter, softened
  • 1/2 cup (100g) dark brown sugar, packed
  • 2 tablespoons (30ml) milk
  • 1 1/2 cups (180g) all-purpose flour
  • 1 teaspoon (5g) baking powder
  • 1 teaspoon (2g) ground cinnamon
  • 1/2 teaspoon (1g) ground ginger
  • 1/4 teaspoon (0.5g) ground cloves
  • 1/4 teaspoon (0.5g) ground nutmeg
  • 1/8 teaspoon (0.25g) ground cardamom
  • Pinch of white pepper
  • 1/4 teaspoon (1.5g) salt

Method

  1. In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter and dark brown sugar until light and fluffy.
  2. Stir in the milk until well combined.
  3. In a separate medium bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, baking powder, ground cinnamon, ground ginger, ground cloves, ground nutmeg, ground cardamom, white pepper, and salt.
  4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until a stiff dough forms. If the dough is too crumbly, add a tiny bit more milk, 1/2 teaspoon (2.5ml) at a time, until it comes together.
  5. Form the dough into a ball, wrap it in plastic film, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to firm up.
  6. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  7. Take small pieces of dough, about the size of a marble (1/2 inch or 1.25 cm in diameter), and roll them between your palms to form small, round balls. Place them about 1/2 inch (1.25 cm) apart on the prepared baking sheet.
  8. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the pepernoten are lightly golden brown and firm to the touch. They will harden more as they cool.
  9. Remove from the oven and let them cool completely on the baking sheet before transferring to an airtight container.

Tips

  • For an authentic speculaas spice blend, you can purchase pre-mixed "speculaaskruiden" or "koekkruiden" and use 2 teaspoons (4g) in place of the individual spices.
  • Ensure the pepernoten are fully cooled before storing to maintain their crisp texture. They can be stored in an airtight container for up to two weeks.
  • Vary the spice levels to your preference; some like a stronger ginger or clove flavor.
